blind.description: A stylized low-poly wooden crate or bin filled with cut wood chunks, logs, and scrap offcuts. The crate has dark moss-green wooden corner posts and trim, light tan wooden side planks, and contains various irregular chopped logs and timber blocks with exposed tree rings and grain textures. Surfaces are solid, manifold, and cleanly modeled in a hand-painted game-asset style.
blind.from_above: A rectangular green-bordered wooden box densely filled with light-yellow chopped wood offcuts and circular log cross-sections.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 1.8 feet tall (roughly one-fourth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide.
